Changed implementation only:
- OpenAIChatTranslateService.translate uses requests timeout=(5,105) (connect/read) below the existing120s no-progress limit. HTTP errors preserve up to4096 server-response characters in HTTPError. Request failures log class, http_translate stage, provider/model, elapsed, status and traceback. Exceptions propagate. No extra retry or translation/model parameter change.
- linux_supervisor's loopback port reservation sets SO_REUSEADDR before bind, allowing ordinary TIME_WAIT reuse. No SO_REUSEPORT is set. An active listening socket still prevents binding. All four reservations still precede any model launch; health still requires HTTP200 plus the run's actual listener-PID ownership. No existing service is adopted, and no port/cleanup/deadline/floor rule changed.

PCM path is consistent: xt_dub invokes FFmpeg -ar16000 -ac1 -fs16le; xt_client sends3200-byte100ms frames; session reassembles FIFO into2560samples=.16s; pcm_bytes_to_float32 divides int16 by32768; Qwen service WAV encoder writes mono16kPCM16; server converts PCM16 back tofloat32/32768. SDK buffers until a full decoder chunk and re-feeds accumulated audio for each step (qwen3_asr.py716–755). The installed demo CLI instead defaults1.0s/unfixed4; do not claim a universal2s recommendation.

Here those history entries are HTTP request audio chunks, typically.16s: only.64s replay, not4 decoder chunks. Prefix commit rebuilds state from that history, and the step limit counts service calls, so60 typicalcalls is9.6s of fed audio. SDK audio context grows between resets, but frequent early punctuation commits can rebuild it with very short context.
